147-4875-6974.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Ashling's Command
147-4875-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Ashling's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4875-6974.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

3899-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-4694-5805-7306.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

62-833-1671-3827.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-833-1671-3827.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Simic Growth Chamber, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2301-2738-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Abzan Ascendancy, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-3129-4365-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

851-1308-4365-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

553-1470-5957.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Kianne.
In response, cast Hinder by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

2843-3175-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

396-6972-7137.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Cytoplast Manipulator.
396-6972-7137.description:
Kill Cytoplast Manipulator.
When Cytoplast Manipulator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its graft ability.
When Cytoplast Manipulator enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Cytoplast Manipulator triggers, moving a +1/+1 counter from it to the creature token. Cytoplast Manipulator dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

339-647-677-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

586-997-5060-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-997-5060-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1987-2468-3094-4087.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Lavabrink Floodgates and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2054-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {U} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

372-4863-5530.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Another Round exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Revolutionist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Another Round.
372-4863-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Another Round.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2867-4636-5330-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1479-2232-3908.notablePrerequisites:
Spark Double is a copy of Kodama of the East Tree.
An additional nonartifact permanent card in your hand that you are able to play.
An additional nonartifact permanent card on the battlefield that shares a type with the card in your hand and that has an equal or lesser mana cost.
1479-2232-3908.description:
Play the nonartifact permanent in your hand.
When it enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and both copies of Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other nonartifact permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the first Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the permanent you returned in step 3 from your hand onto the battlefield.
When that permanent enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the second Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the permanent you played in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 5, declining to use it unless desired.
Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 2, putting the permanent you returned in step 6 from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
This combo results in Infinite ETB and Infinite LTB if a permanent involved is a creature, and/or Infinite landfall triggers if it is a land.

526-1692-2781.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Felidar Guardian.
You control at least one nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1692-2781.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Felidar Guardian token.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-1233-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-1233-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

457-1912-2043-3263.description:
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {U}.
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {2}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {U}.
Activate Urza, Prince of Kroog by paying {1}, creating a token copy of Biomancer's Familiar that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Urza, Lord High Artificer's first ability by tapping the Biomancer's Familiar token, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 5.

2047-2793-4501.notablePrerequisites: Minimus Containment and Mechanized Production attached to Ugin's Nexus.
2047-2793-4501.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1737-2499-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor.
The Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, untapping Prototype Portal and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

2607-4843.notablePrerequisites:
Virtus does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Virtus.
2607-4843.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Virtus.
Virtus triggers, causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

57-1267-3745.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents can not block Medomai token.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-1267-3745.description:
Pay {2}{R} and tap Feldon to create a copy of Identity Thief with haste.
Attack with the Identity Thief token, triggering it and exiling Medomai the Ageless until end of turn.
the Identity Thief token will deal combat damage as a copy of Medomai the Ageless, granting you an extra turn.
At the end of the turn, Medomai the Ageless returns to the battlefield.
Sacrifice the token.
Repeat for infinite turns.

2034-2281-5237.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier, adding {C}{C}.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
